summary: In src/sensei_top/cli.py's cmd_report, added '(no deck)' as the last argument to all four COALESCE deck-label expressions: v_deck_winrate (COALESCE(deck_name, substr(deck_id,1,8), '(no deck)')), v_play_draw_winrate, v_deck_game_length, and v_deck_turn_curves (each COALESCE(d.name, substr(v.deck_id,1,8), '(no deck)')). This labels matches with no deck_id as '(no deck)' rather than NULL, so the play/draw label formatting and slicing (and the game-length section) no longer crash and the report runs to completion. No other changes were made; print formats are untouched. Both check commands pass: uv run pytest -q tests/test_cli_report.py (2 passed) and uv run ruff check . (all checks passed).
